messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.

Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)

We have verified the order history you referenced and have adjusted our pricing to reflect this data. Please note that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our offer is a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, we are willing to accept the AS-14404 index clause and a 24-month contract, offering €5.51 per unit with 60 days payment terms, specifically a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our commercial management has reviewed your request and the binding volume commitment of 94,800 kg per year. In response to your improved offer and this volume commitment, we have adjusted our price to €5.37 per unit. This offer is based on the 24-month contract with 60 days payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause.

Currently, our main Angebot stands at a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €5.37 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for providing the official forecast data, which we have verified and incorporated into our assessment. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.37 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

In recognition of your improved offer and the confirmed volume, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.34 per unit for a 24-month contract with 60 days payment terms, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We believe this step brings us closer to a mutually beneficial agreement. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
